description: Manages external links associated with various business entities such as partners, projects, or contacts. These links can point to websites, documents, or other relevant online resources.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of links associated with a specific entity and its unique identifier. You can specify sorting options for the results.

entity.description: The type of entity the links are associated with (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Contact').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity.

OrderBy.description: The field to order the results by.

Ascending.description: Set to true for ascending order, false for descending. Overrides 'Direction'.

Direction.description: Set to true for ascending order, false for descending. Ignored if 'Ascending' is provided.

PageSize.description: The number of items per page.

example_uses: Get all links for the 'Partner' entity with ID 123.
List links for 'Project' 456, ordered by 'Name' in ascending order, retrieving the first 10 results.
Retrieve the second page of links for 'Contact' 789, with 5 links per page.
endpoints.when_to_use: To retrieve a collection of external links associated with a specific business entity (e.g., Partner, Project, Contact) and its unique identifier, with options for pagination and sorting.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link record and associates it with a specified entity.

Entity.description: The type of entity the link will be associated with (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Contact').

EntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity to associate the link with.

Url.description: The URL of the external link.

Name.description: A descriptive name for the link.

example_uses: Create a new link for 'Partner' ID 123, named 'Official Website' with URL 'https://partner.com'.
Add a document link for 'Project' 456, URL 'https://projectdocs.org/report.pdf', name 'Annual Report'.
Register a new external resource for 'Contact' 789, URL 'https://linkedin.com/contactprofile', name 'LinkedIn Profile'.
endpoints.when_to_use: To add a new external link record and associate it with an existing business entity.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing link record identified by its unique ID.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the link to update.

Entity.description: The type of entity the link is associated with (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Contact').

EntityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity the link is associated with.

Url.description: The new URL for the link.

Name.description: The new descriptive name for the link.

example_uses: Update the URL of link ID 1 to 'https://newpartnerwebsite.com'.
Change the name of link ID 5 to 'Updated Project Document'.
Modify link ID 10, setting its URL to 'https://newresource.net' and name to 'New Resource'.
endpoints.when_to_use: To modify the details of an existing external link record, identified by its unique ID.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link record from the system using its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to delete.

example_uses: Can you delete the link that has an ID of 3?
endpoints.when_to_use: To permanently remove an external link record from the system using its unique identifier.
